interface.shortDescription: REEL films and ONCE life stories
interface.longDescription: PlotPickle Studio is an on-demand, ChatGPT-native creative production system with two paths: REEL for movies and ONCE for life stories. The approved Skin V1 design system (v0.8.38) makes HOME, Storyboard, Story Map, Mini-Block/25-shot grid and source-backed Image Review use consistent layouts and evidence presentation. Skin V1 is a packaged design/template contract rendered in normal ChatGPT replies; it is not a separately hosted persistent graphical app or a guarantee of pixel-identical rendering on every ChatGPT host. The Save/Lock transaction interaction design is approved, while real writes still require secure current source/bytes, version guards, validation and independent readback. Existing PPF screenplay reader, 81 lessons, Character and World Builders, Layout Sheets, Assets, Posters, Reports, Pitch Decks, animatic, editing, Sound, Suno, fal motion and BUZZ/Modem plans remain available. Provider costs require individual prior approval; no status, media or persistence is invented. No mandatory Windows app, GitHub account or sidebar. Production Handoff Skin V1 layout and other unreviewed surfaces are not yet approved. The v0.8.38 REEL workspace includes New Idea, Import Script, Continue Film, Explore Tools, stacked mobile Storyboard Review, and optional five-page/25-panel graphic-novel reading for each Mini-Block. Actual graphic-novel pages and PPF sources remain private in the creator's Library; no project images are bundled. Version 0.8.39 added the owner-approved official The Third Bell edition route for the first Mini-Block of Blocks 01 and 02, with ten pages and 50 panels. Version 0.8.40 adds native in-chat fal player routing through the separately connected fal app, source-linked multi-shot generation, completed clip library save/readback, and an offline no-spend three-shot 24fps/216-frame conform and verification helper when the actual MP4 bytes can be accessed. The observed three-shot provider test completed and saved real MP4s; remote MP4 byte intake, authenticated editor connectivity, actual three-shot editor import, and native PPF video registration remain independently unverified. Nothing in this plugin installs a custom fal player, pays for media without per-batch approval, or changes story Save/Lock merely by playback.
